name: FAA Powered-Lift Pilot Certification and Operations Final Rule
update_frequency: Final rule with implementation guidance and later amendments
known_limitations: The rule creates pilot, instructor, and operating pathways. It does not grant an aircraft type certificate, operator certificate, route authority, vertiport approval, local acceptance, or commercial service.
automation_notes: Track type certificates, production certificates, operator approvals, pilot qualifications, infrastructure, airspace procedures, and commercial operations separately.
notes: October 2024 final rule includes permanent amendments and a ten-year Special Federal Aviation Regulation.
